title: Soul Shard
html:
Source not yet observed

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) and each re-enchant to one of these uses one:

  • of the Sage (gems: Iolite + Sapphire + any gem)
  • of the Wellspring (gems: Diamond + Pearl + Pearl)
  • Sapphire rings and pendants (their gem: Gem Sapphire)

Dropped by Ghost: Shade, Wraith, Banshee, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Reforging & reagents for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.

How to get it

No monster drops recorded for this item.
